<https://better-vis.njtierney.com>

**Prerequisites**

- Basic R programming experience
- No familiarity with ggplot2 required
- Some dplyr is handy, but there is an appendix if you want it

**Learning outcomes**

- Build a plot from the grammar of graphics, rather than copying an example
- Get your data into the shape ggplot2 needs, and diagnose a plot that came out wrong
- Know what a geom computes before it draws, and control it with scales and coords
- Arrange a plot around the comparison you actually care about, using facets and position
- Strip out what is in the way, and know what your summary is hiding
- Direct a reader's attention with order, colour, and contrast, in a way that works for colourblind readers
- Polish a plot with labels, themes, and alt text, and save it so it looks the same outside RStudio
- Critique any graph, including your own, with four questions
